review_fix.finding: Bootstrap can verify the requested activation historically while deriving a feature acknowledgment for independent host membership. Returning that cached evidence for first verification skips its current preconditions.
review_fix.change: Both implementations reuse completed activation evidence only for historical evaluation. First verification always rechecks the transcript, request interval, live authority, target validity/revocation and current admission/binding preconditions.

independent_regressions.author_boundary: The separate suite author read the accepted contracts and signing helpers, never either implementation.
pairs: Current request after issuer expiry with exact root retention checkpoints
independent_regressions.before_fix: Both probes built from the reviewed commit incorrectly accepted all three first requests. All three historical success controls and all 107 existing requests passed.
independent_regressions.after_fix: Both rebuilt probes reject all three first requests and preserve all historical controls. All 113 history requests pass; all 1785 conformance checks pass per implementation.
independent_regressions.multiple_faults: Deadline cases allow expired or state_conflict; expired-authority cases allow authority_expired or state_conflict. Existing current membership is also invalid in each first request.
